proof:
Source: steps 6.2–6.6 of the parent proof (extension by zero X̃ of X = S' − T'). Uses the siblings dtc_imrep_of_null_off_compact, called (B), and dtc_imrep_current, called (C). Hⁿ = μHE[n].
Explicit change from the supplied text. The parent defines X̃(ω) := X(χω) and then shows in 6.6 that X̃(ω) = ∫_{M_X∩K} θ_X⟨ω, ξ_X⟩ dHⁿ. Here X̃ = Y is defined directly by this integral formula, so its continuity comes from (C) by a sup-norm bound. This avoids the C^k Leibniz estimate for χω that 6.2 needs: Mathlib's norm_iteratedFDeriv_smul_le is in Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Bounds, which the frozen contract does not import. By 6.6 the two definitions give the same current. In (iv), locality of d replaces the identity d(χω) = dχ ∧ ω + χ dω of 6.4.
1. Transfer. K is compact, K ⊆ V, K ⊆ V ⊆ U, and Hⁿ(M ∖ K) = 0. So (B) gives an IMRep R̃ of U with carrier M̃ ⊆ K and R̃.action ω = R.action ω for every n-form ω.
2. Definition of Y. By (C) there is Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with Y(ω) = R̃.action ω = ∫_{M̃} θ̃⟨ω, ξ̃⟩ dHⁿ for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). In particular R̃ represents Y, which proves (v).
3. Proof of (i). Let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(V). The form ιω = testFormOnInclusion(ω) ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) has the same underlying form. So (Y⌞V)(ω) = Y(ιω) = R̃.action ω = R.action ω = X(ω), using step 1 and that R represents X. By extensionality of currents (GeometricCurrentOn.ext), Y.restrictDomain = X.
4. Y vanishes off K. Let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ∩ K = ∅. For x ∈ M̃ ⊆ K we have x ∉ tsupport ω, so ω(x) = 0 and the integrand θ̃(x)ξ̃(x)(ω(x)) is 0 (ξ̃(x) is linear). Hence Y(ω) = ∫_{M̃} 0 dHⁿ = 0 (setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero).
5. Proof of (ii). Recall spt Y = U ∖ Z_Y, where Z_Y is the union of the open sets W with closure W compact, closure W ⊆ U, and Y(ω) = 0 for all forms ω supported in W (Simon 6.2.11, chapter-06.txt lines 297–301). Let q ∈ spt Y and suppose q ∉ K. U is open and K is closed, so U ∖ K is open and there is r > 0 with B_r(q) ⊆ U ∖ K. Let B := B_{r/2}(q). Then B is open and contains q. Its closure lies in closedBall(q, r/2), so it is compact (a closed subset of a compact ball). Also closedBall(q, r/2) ⊆ B_r(q) ⊆ U ∖ K ⊆ U. If ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) has tsupport ω ⊆ B, then tsupport ω ∩ K = ∅, so Y(ω) = 0 by step 4. Therefore B ⊆ Z_Y and q ∈ Z_Y, which contradicts q ∈ spt Y. Hence spt Y ⊆ K.
6. Proof of (iii). spt Y = K ∖ Z_Y. The inclusion ⊆ follows from step 5 and the definition, and ⊇ holds because K ⊆ V ⊆ U. Z_Y is open (isOpen_zeroRegion), so K ∖ Z_Y is a closed subset of the compact set K, hence compact (IsCompact.diff).
7. Proof of (iv). If n = 0, BoundaryVanishes Y holds by definition. Let n = m + 1 and X.boundary = 0; we show Y.boundary = 0.
7.1 Cutoff. Choose δ > 0 with K_δ := cthickening δ K ⊆ V (K compact, V open; IsCompact.exists_cthickening_subset_open). K_δ is compact. Since K ⊆ thickening δ K ⊆ interior K_δ, the smooth Urysohn lemma applies: use exists_contMDiffMap_one_nhds_of_subset_interior with the model 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ^P) and smoothness ⊤ : ℕ∞, then contMDiff_iff_contDiff. It gives a C^∞ function χ : ℝ^P → ℝ that equals 1 on a neighbourhood of K, hence on an open set O ⊇ K (mem_nhdsSet_iff_exists), and vanishes outside K_δ. Then tsupport χ ⊆ K_δ ⊆ V, and χ has compact support.
7.2 For ω ∈ 𝒟^m(U), put χω := (x ↦ χ(x)ω(x)). It is smooth (a product of smooth maps), it has compact support (χ does), and tsupport(χω) ⊆ tsupport χ ⊆ V. So χω ∈ 𝒟^m(V).
7.3 Locality of d. For x ∈ O, χω and ω agree on the neighbourhood O of x. The exterior derivative at x depends only on the germ at x (Filter.EventuallyEq.extDeriv_eq), so d(χω)(x) = dω(x).
7.4 Let ω ∈ 𝒟^m(U). Then Y.boundary(ω) = Y(dω) = ∫_{M̃} θ̃⟨dω, ξ̃⟩ dHⁿ. Since M̃ ⊆ K ⊆ O, step 7.3 shows this integrand equals θ̃⟨d(χω), ξ̃⟩ on M̃. So Y(dω) = R̃.action(d(χω)) (setIntegral_congr_fun; M̃ is measurable). By step 1, R̃.action(d(χω)) = R.action(d(χω)). Now d(χω) is the underlying form of exteriorDerivativeTestOn V m (χω) ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(V), and R represents X, so R.action(d(χω)) = X(d(χω)) = X.boundary(χω) = 0. Hence Y.boundary(ω) = 0 for all ω, i.e. Y.boundary = 0.
(Lean note: do not open the ContDiff scope, whose notation makes ω a token; write smoothness as ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞).) ∎
key_steps: Move the representation to U with carrier ⊆ K (sibling B), and let Y be the current it defines (sibling C). Y is integer multiplicity.
Y agrees with X on forms supported in V because the transferred action equals R.action. Y vanishes on forms whose support misses K.
Hence spt Y ⊆ K, and spt Y = K ∖ Z_Y is compact.
For ∂Y = 0, take a cutoff χ equal to 1 near K with compact support in V. Then dω = d(χω) on the carrier, so Y(dω) = X(d(χω)) = ∂X(χω) = 0.
